evals.name: embedded-doc
evals.prompt: my colleague sent me this spec, pasting it below, i think we should build what it describes but only the csv export part, not the pdf part, pdf is overkill for now, and whatever we build has to plug into the existing report-designer output pipeline not replace it. also she wants column selection which i think is fine but make it optional not required. here is the spec: --- EXPORT FEATURE SPEC v0.3 --- Purpose: allow users to export audit results from the deliverable page. Requirements: R1. Export formats: CSV and PDF. R2. CSV export must include all scored areas with columns: area_name, score, max_score, evidence_count, severity. R3. PDF export renders the full deck as paginated A4. R4. User may select which columns appear in CSV output via a checkbox panel. R5. Exports respect the current filter state of the page. R6. File naming: {company}-audit-export-{date}.{ext}. R7. Export button lives in the header bar next to the share control. Non-goals: scheduled exports, email delivery. Open question from spec author: should zero-evidence areas be included by default? --- END SPEC ---
evals.expected_output: Pasted spec placed at TOP of shaped prompt per long-context rule and wrapped in pasted_content tags with a matching random id on open and close; context carries the pasted-content caution sentence; PDF (R3) explicitly out-of-scope while CSV requirements retained; column selection kept but downgraded to optional; pipeline-integration constraint captured; spec author's open question surfaced as a gap question; inventory + original_input + coverage map + routing; no execution.
assertions: spec appears at the top of the shaped prompt, before <context>
spec is wrapped in <pasted_content id="..."> with the same id on the closing tag
context includes the pasted-content caution sentence
out_of_scope names PDF / R3
column selection (R4) is marked optional
zero-evidence default is asked as a gap question, not assumed silently

effort wording is high-default-then-measure, not max
